title: On Boolean sublattices of finite partition lattices
summary: We investigate maximal Boolean sublattices of the partition lattice Part(U) of a finite universe U. First, any largest size Boolean sublattice of Part(U) can be formed using all partitions whose blocks are subtrees of a tree with vertex set U. It is shown that a maximal Boolean sublattice of Part(U) always contains the least and the largest elements of Part(U). Boolean sublattices B of PartU containing 0 are characterized by a certain condition imposed on the cycles of a linear hypergraph corresponding to the atoms of B on the set U.
